Government Approves ₹340 Crore for Sohna Elevated Corridor in Haryana

The government has approved ₹340 crore for the construction of a 2.75-kilometer, six-lane elevated corridor in Sohna, Haryana. The project will improve the intersection of NH-919 and NH-248A.
